name: 24262-loraprefill-30ba3b-tp4
model: Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507, plus ONE rank-32 LoRA adapter served on top of it. Ungated; the base is already in the local HF cache at 57 GB and the adapter is on local disk.
parallelism: TP=4 over four GPUs of one node. DP=1, EP=1, PP=1, no DP attention, no router in front and no external cache tier. ~15 GB of weights per rank, 24 KiB of KV per token per rank (the 4 KV heads shard one per rank), and ~2 GB per rank of LoRA pool. TP=4 is also the smallest width that holds this operating point: four resident 65,536-token prompts are 262,144 live tokens, i.e. ~25 GB of KV, which does not fit beside 61 GB of weights on one card.
architecture: Qwen3MoeForCausalLM, 30.5B total parameters with ~3.3B active per token. 48 decoder layers, hidden 2048, vocab 151936, max_position_embeddings 262144. GQA: 32 query heads over 4 key/value heads at head_dim 128, rope_theta 1e7. MoE: 128 routed experts, top-8 per token, moe_intermediate_size 768, no shared expert. EVERY LAYER IS SPARSE -- decoder_sparse_step 1 and mlp_only_layers [] -- so all 48 layers carry the expert stack and none of them is a dense feed-forward shortcut. bf16, no quantization_config. THE ADAPTER: r=32, alpha=32, dropout 0, target_modules all-linear, 674 tensors totalling 1.98 GB in fp32, of which 288 are the experts' w1/w3/w2 lora_A/lora_B over all 48 layers. Its expert tensors are in SHARED-OUTER form -- w1/w3 lora_A and w2 lora_B carry a leading dimension of 1 while their partners carry all 128 experts -- which is a property of the weights, not a setting, and is declared to the engine rather than left to auto-detection.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=4 as the step-0 value. Warmup the first 25%, bounded at 240 requests with a 1800 s safety cap, seed 42. ~180 requests are measured, so the p95 tail is ~9 requests. FOUR IS THE DECLARED OPERATING POINT and is the one dimension of this setup that is not free: the item is declared at streams=4 and is not comparable at another value, so a cliff search that walks it upward is answering a different question.
workload: guidellm synthetic_text, SINGLE TURN, no prefix buckets, seed 42. Prompts are 65,536 tokens EXACTLY (min=max) and generations 32 tokens exactly, with ignore_eos so no request stops early. That is 2048 prompt tokens for every generated token: the run is prompt processing with a decode tail attached, and at the chunk size declared here each request is eight prefill passes followed by 32 decode steps. Radix cache is OFF, so nothing is reused between requests and every prompt is a full prefill. Every request carries lora_path my_lora in its body, so 100% of the traffic is served through the adapter and none of it through the base model -- a batch of base-model requests exercises a different path and would not be this setup.
purpose: A long-document analysis assistant on a 30B sparse model with one LoRA adapter, four concurrent 64K-token requests across four GPUs.
launch:
# The launch config, in `sglang serve` CLI form. Flat keys only -- a nested block is dropped
# silently by the flat parser, and the engine then runs without what this file declares.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507
tp-size: 4

# `lora-paths` is a local directory rather than a repo id: the adapter is published as an HF
# *dataset* repo, and sglang resolves a non-directory value with `snapshot_download(path)`, i.e.
# as a model repo, which 404s. configs/env.yaml records how the snapshot was made.
enable-lora: true
lora-paths: ["my_lora=${SYSAGENT_DATA}/models/lora-diff-Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507"]
max-lora-rank: 32
experts-shared-outer-loras: true
lora-use-virtual-experts: true
max-loras-per-batch: 8
# Runner hazard: the default extra adapter-free decode-graph set frees the adapter graphs' attention metadata, and the first adapter decode step faults (CUDA illegal memory access).
no-record-nolora-graph: true

moe-runner-backend: triton
lora-backend: triton
disable-radix-cache: true
chunked-prefill-size: 8192

# Deliberately absent, all stock: host / port / served-model-name (owned by the serving layer;
# the adapter is selected per request via scenario.json `body.lora_path`), mem-fraction-static,
# context-length, attention-backend, cuda-graph-max-bs, max-running-requests, dtype,
# quantization, ep-size, speculative-*.
